answer: A farm of 143 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are published in ivory, queued in comet, and juniper publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 48 identities per epoch. A farm of 1790 identities would post 3840 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
